node.title: Re: matching substring in url
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
How about m{/(\w+)(?:$|;arg=)}? ([https://webperl.zero-g.net/regex.html#flags=®ex=%2F(%5Cw%2B)(%3F%3A%24%7C%3Barg%3D)&samp1=%2Fblah1%2Fblah2%2Fblah3%2F1234567890%3Barg%3DAAA123BBB456CCC&samp2=%2Fblah1%2Fblah2%2Fblah3%2F1234567890|WebPerl Regex Tester])

However, obviously there may be cases where the regex might not work. As you've only given two examples, that's not really enough to confirm. Please see [id://1201201] for how to write more test cases for regexen. Or, you might want to look into using a proper parser such as [mod://URI] (Update: [choroba] just posted an [id://11108488|example]).
